fields.label: Key
fields.description: Literal key inside the runtime context dict, as the script reads it: e.g. e.state.context.get("so").

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown to the operator in the mobile app. Falls back to Key.

fields.label: Field Type
fields.options:
Data
Int
Float
Check
Link
Select

fields.label: Link DocType
fields.description: The DocType the app offers to pick from (e.g. Sales Order). Only for Link.

fields.label: Options
fields.description: One option per line, for Select. A Link uses "Link DocType" instead (an older row may still carry the DocType name here).

fields.label: Default Value
fields.description: Seeded into a fresh session context, so the operator starts with this value already chosen. A Link is checked against Link Filters.

fields.label: Show In App
fields.description: Uncheck for internal bookkeeping keys the operator should never see.

fields.label: App Editable
fields.description: The mobile app may write this key.

fields.label: Primary
fields.description: The entity this session is about (e.g. the Sales Order being packed). Setting it from the app clears every other key except those marked Preserve On Switch. Requires App Editable.

fields.label: Preserve On Switch
fields.description: This key survives a primary switch. Use for operator choices that outlive the entity (printer, box type).

fields.label: Blocks Switch
fields.description: While this key holds a non-empty value, the app refuses to switch the primary entity and asks the operator to finish or reset the session first. Use for keys recording work already committed to the database.

fields.label: Editable In States
fields.description: One state name per line: the app may write this key only while the session sits in one of them, and shows it read-only elsewhere. Blank — editable in every state.

fields.label: Enter State
fields.description: State to enter when the app sets this key. Leave blank to stay in the current state. Must be a state of this script.

fields.label: Link Filters
fields.description: JSON object of frappe filters restricting the options offered for a Link field, e.g. {"docstatus": 1}. Also re-applied server-side when the app writes the value.

fields.label: Link Order By
fields.description: Order clause for Link options, e.g. transaction_date desc.
